mapper.select: SELECT ( to_jsonb(t) - 'ins_id' - 'ins_dt' - 'upd_id' - 'upd_dt' || jsonb_build_object( 'personNm', t.person_nm, 'examDt', t.exam_dt, 'expireDt', t.expire_dt, 'filePath', t.file_path, 'fileNm', t.file_nm, 'useYn', t.use_yn ) )::text FROM tbl_health_cert t WHERE t.co_cd = #{coCd, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND t.idx = #{idx, mode=IN, jdbcType=BIGINT}
